text:
London gets much more rain than hot or dry cities such as Dubai (about 100 mm a year), Cairo (about 25 mm), Riyadh (about 100 mm), Las Vegas (about 120 mm), and Los Angeles (about 370 mm), against roughly 600 mm in London. New York City is not the answer, because it averages about 1,250 mm a year, roughly twice London's rainfall. These are approximate long-term averages that I haven't checked against a live source.

CONFIDENCE: 85
